relics.name: An Unspent Lamp
relics.description: A tower lamp still holding its charge after a century of burning. Nobody has worked out what it is drawing on.
relics.discovery_note: The party carries up a lamp that is still, impossibly, unspent.

relics.name: The Foreman's Seal
relics.description: A supervisor's stamp for closing work orders. The last order it closed sealed the stair below the office.
relics.discovery_note: A foreman's seal comes up, its last impression still legible in wax.

relics.name: Molten Collar
relics.description: A ring of mineral glass formed in a vent and cooled around nothing at all.
relics.discovery_note: A collar of vent-glass is eased out of the rock intact.

relics.name: Flue Scale
relics.description: A sheet of baked residue peeled whole from a duct wall, layered like a season's growth.
relics.discovery_note: A whole sheet of flue scale comes away without cracking.

relics.name: Cast Fitting
relics.description: A finished coupling from the abandoned pour, cast to a tolerance the guild's forge cannot match.
relics.discovery_note: A cast fitting is recovered, finer than anything the forge can make.

relics.name: Pressure Seal
relics.description: A boiler seal that has held for a hundred years and is still holding when it is lifted free.
relics.discovery_note: A pressure seal is worked loose without venting what it held.

relics.name: Cinder Shell
relics.description: Shell fragment from the ash banks, thicker than any egg the hatchery has handled.
relics.discovery_note: A fragment of cinder shell is lifted from the warm ash.

relics.name: Gilded Leash
relics.description: A handler's lead in gold wire, sized for something that was never a dog.
relics.discovery_note: A gilded leash is recovered from an open pen.

relics.name: Brass Tally
relics.description: An exhibition tally plate, stamped with a count and a word in no language the archive holds.
relics.discovery_note: A brass tally is prised off the menagerie wall.

relics.name: Keeper's Goad
relics.description: A handler's goad that hums when carried and stops when set down.
relics.discovery_note: A keeper's goad is taken from the rack, still humming.

relics.name: Warded Harness
relics.description: Restraint harness cut for a shape the guild has no name for, and warded on the inside.
relics.discovery_note: A warded harness comes up, its buckles facing inward.

relics.name: Brood Ledger
relics.description: A breeding record listing lineages, dates, and outcomes, kept in a steady hand for far too long.
relics.discovery_note: A brood ledger is recovered, the entries unbroken for centuries.

relics.name: Unclaimed Lot
relics.description: An auction lot still boxed and tagged, its buyer's column blank.
relics.discovery_note: An unclaimed lot is carried out, still tagged and boxed.

relics.name: Auction Ledger
relics.description: Sale records for things the tower caught. The final page lists the guild's own founding year.
relics.discovery_note: An auction ledger surfaces, and the last page gives the guild pause.

relics.name: Sealed Index
relics.description: An index to the tower's records, warded shut from the reader's side.
relics.discovery_note: A sealed index is taken from the archive, still shut.

relics.name: Ward Key
relics.description: A key cut for the archive ward, found on the wrong side of it.
relics.discovery_note: A ward key is found lying on the wrong side of its own door.

relics.name: Living Cartogram
relics.description: A map of the tower that revises itself. Corridors appear on it days before they appear underfoot.
relics.discovery_note: A cartogram comes up that has redrawn itself since it was picked up.

relics.name: Catalogued Relic
relics.description: An object from a numbered niche, entered in a catalogue that is still being kept.
relics.discovery_note: An object is taken from its niche, and the catalogue is amended.

relics.name: Niche Seal
relics.description: The stone plug from a reliquary niche, carved with an entry number and a caution.
relics.discovery_note: A niche seal is drawn out whole, its caution still crisp.

relics.name: Governor Cog
relics.description: A regulating gear from machinery that did not stop when it was removed.
relics.discovery_note: A governor cog is lifted clear, and the hall keeps running without it.

relics.name: Understair Keystone
relics.description: A keystone from the older stonework, cut for a span no human mason would attempt.
relics.discovery_note: A keystone from the older work is brought up, impossibly well cut.

relics.name: Descent Marker
relics.description: A depth marker from the long stair, numbered in a sequence that does not start at the top.
relics.discovery_note: A descent marker is recovered, numbered from somewhere below.

relics.name: Answering Stone
relics.description: A fragment of the chorus vault that repeats what is said to it, an hour later.
relics.discovery_note: A fragment of the answering stone is carried out, still replying.

relics.name: Empty Socket
relics.description: A mounting from the hollow works, shaped around something that was removed carefully.
relics.discovery_note: A socket mounting is recovered, its fittings undamaged.

relics.name: Feeder Line
relics.description: A length of conduit that ran from the core to the machinery, still faintly warm.
relics.discovery_note: A length of feeder line comes up warm to the touch.

relics.name: Guildmark Seal
relics.description: A seal bearing the guild's own mark, cut before the guild existed.
relics.discovery_note: A seal is recovered carrying a mark the guild has used for one generation.

relics.name: Core Ember
relics.description: A coal from the core that has not cooled and does not consume anything.
relics.discovery_note: An ember is carried up from the core, still burning nothing.

relics.name: Founding Shell
relics.description: Shell from the core's own clutch, matching the fragments kept in the guild's first record.
relics.discovery_note: A shell fragment matches the one in the guild's founding record exactly.
